basics.name: C S Vaishakh
basics.label: Fullstack Developer
basics.summary: Artificial Intelligence & Data Science undergraduate with an interest in full-stack development and machine learning. Experienced in building applications using TypeScript (React, Next.js, Express.js etc.), backend systems with Go (Fiber and Gin, Postgres), AI/ML applications in Python using FastAPI and related machine learning frameworks.

education.institution: St. Joseph's College of Engineering and Technology, Palai

projects.name: Quickhand
highlights: Implemented role-based access control across two user roles, securing Fiber v3 routes with stateless JWTs.
Built an authenticated WebSocket layer broadcasting real-time job alerts to matched handymen.
Structured the codebase as a Go workspace monorepo pairing the Fiber API with a TanStack Start frontend.

projects.name: Snip
highlights: Built a URL shortener with a Go (Gin) REST API, React dashboard, JWT auth, and collision-safe codes.
Cut redirect latency by fronting PostgreSQL with a Redis cache on the public redirect path.
Deployed the frontend on Vercel and the backend on AWS EC2 behind Caddy via GitHub Actions CI/CD.

projects.name: PortfolyoIQ
highlights: Engineered a privacy-preserving rebalancing platform: Next.js client, Express API, FastAPI model service.
Trained logistic regression models in-browser with TensorFlow.js, eliminating raw portfolio data uploads.
Implemented Federated Averaging (FedAvg) on the Express aggregator to synchronize local model updates.
Self-hosted all three services on AWS EC2 behind Caddy via systemd, deployed by GitHub Actions.

projects.name: ONT Monitor
highlights: Built a Go microservice (Fiber v3, GORM) ingesting real-time ONT status change events.
Implemented thread-safe in-memory queues and a worker pool to evaluate outages without race conditions.
Integrated the Twilio API to dispatch outage and recovery WhatsApp alerts on state transitions.
